prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1483; do not mention it.)
text: This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision referenced above, which involved a low-speed head-on impact. Our client has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation, and the full extent of those injuries and associated losses is still being determined. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative has been in contact with our client, please inform us of that contact so that we may address it appropriately. We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page, within fourteen days of receipt of this letter. We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, claim file notes, adjuster reports, and any electronic records. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained. We look forward to your prompt response.
